description: Add a page to a wiki, as a DRAFT - nobody can read it, and it is in no search or recall, until you publish it with set_page_state. `parent` is the page it sits under (an id or a path); omit it for a page directly under the wiki's home page. `slug` must be unique among its SIBLINGS, not across the wiki, so two branches can each hold a "setup" and neither has to be "setup-2". Link to other pages with [[double brackets]] - use [[section/page]] where a bare title would be ambiguous, because the resolver refuses to guess between equally close matches.

body.description: body is the page's markdown. Omitted, it starts as the title as a heading.

parent.description:
parent is the page to create under - an id or a path. Omit it for a page
 directly under the wiki's root.

slug.description:
slug is the page's own path segment; derived from the title when omitted.
 It must be unique among its SIBLINGS, not across the wiki - two branches can
 each hold a "setup".

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

title.description: title is the page's heading, and the name it is listed under.

wiki.description: wiki is the wiki to add to - its id or slug.

name: create_page

baseRevision.description: base_revision is what to pass to update_page for the first edit.

parent.description: parent is the id of the page above it; empty for the wiki's root.

path.description: path is the page's full path within its wiki, e.g. "handbook/day-one".

restricted.description:
restricted is true when this page sits in a subtree that is fenced off to
 named people - you can see it, so you are one of them.

state.description:
state is one of: draft, awaiting_approval, published,
 published_draft_changes, archived, deletion_scheduled.

title: Create page
